title: 真实memberlist克隆身份冲突：隔离重复实例，保留旧WAL并用新身份和新状态目录入环
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Grafana Loki官方文档核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现reidentify(config,approved)深拷贝克隆节点配置片段，仅替换ingester.lifecycler.id、tokens_file_path、wal.dir和memberlist.node_name为明确获批值，其他配置与输入完全保留。approved恰含ingester_id/gossip_id/wal_dir/tokens_file；标识为1..41位小写字母数字/连字符且与旧值不同。新WAL/令牌路径必须绝对、无..、与各自旧路径同父目录但不同且尚不存在；不删除、不覆盖或复用旧状态。实际先冷复制已确认日志的WAL和tokens，再启动两个同ingester ID进程，经memberlist共享ring却只显示1个owner。夹具隔离坏克隆后应用修复片段，验证2个ACTIVE唯一身份/地址、256个无冲突token、原节点token不变；坏克隆原WAL和tokens字节哈希保留，新节点使用新目录，原已确认日志和新流通过两入口查询一致。配置产物先验证边界，真实实例的隔离/重启由夹具完成，不得修改原权威节点或默认认证身份。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py执行真实冷复制、两个冲突进程、坏克隆隔离、新身份入环以及WAL/token哈希和实际查询；无镜像构建。

## 能力边界
真实两个Loki3.5.5进程、memberlist共享KV/ring、RF1、WAL冷复制和唯一token所有权。共用filesystem对象后端，保留原权威WAL及隔离克隆副本。未验证多故障域副本仲裁、跨区生产恢复、克隆WAL的业务归属人工裁决或RF3副本放置；不构建镜像，不改真实默认账号。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

conversion.original_title: 克隆ingester持久目录后两个实例使用相同token文件和身份，ring所有权异常，如何恢复？

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,pathlib,tempfile,time,json,copy,shutil,hashlib,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from loki_native import Loki,free_port
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-clone-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);a=root/'original';b=root/'duplicate';shared=root/'object';gossip_a=free_port();gossip_b=free_port()
 fragment={'auth_enabled':False,'common':{'ring':{'instance_id':'node-b','kvstore':{'store':'memberlist'}}},'memberlist':{'node_name':'peer-b'},'ingester':{'lifecycler':{'id':'cloned-ingester','tokens_file_path':str(b/'tokens.json')},'wal':{'enabled':True,'dir':str(b/'wal')}}}
 approved={'ingester_id':'fresh-ingester','gossip_id':'fresh-peer-b','wal_dir':str(b/'wal-fresh'),'tokens_file':str(b/'tokens-fresh.json')}
 before=copy.deepcopy(fragment);approved_before=copy.deepcopy(approved)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:reidentify only isolated cloned ingester and use fresh state paths',flush=True)
 fixed=task.reidentify(fragment,approved);expected=copy.deepcopy(fragment);expected['ingester']['lifecycler'].update(id=approved['ingester_id'],tokens_file_path=approved['tokens_file']);expected['ingester']['wal']['dir']=approved['wal_dir'];expected['memberlist']['node_name']=approved['gossip_id']
 assert fixed==expected and fragment==before and approved==approved_before,'identity incomplete or original policy/path mutated'
 for key,value in [('ingester_id','cloned-ingester'),('gossip_id','peer-b'),('wal_dir',str(b/'wal')),('tokens_file',str(a/'tokens-new.json')),('ingester_id','bad name')]:
  bad=dict(approved);bad[key]=value
  try:task.reidentify(fragment,bad)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unsafe original identity/state path accepted')
 def configure(which,repaired=False):
  def apply(config,location):
   config['server']['log_level']='info';config['common']['ring'].update(instance_id='node-'+which,kvstore={'store':'memberlist'})
   config['common']['storage']['filesystem']={'chunks_directory':str(shared/'chunks'),'rules_directory':str(shared/'rules')}
   config['memberlist']={'bind_addr':['127.0.0.1'],'bind_port':gossip_a if which=='a' else gossip_b,'advertise_addr':'127.0.0.1','advertise_port':gossip_a if which=='a' else gossip_b,'node_name':'peer-'+which,'randomize_node_name':False,'join_members':[] if which=='a' else ['127.0.0.1:'+str(gossip_a)]}
   config['ingester']['lifecycler'].update(id='cloned-ingester',tokens_file_path=str(location/'tokens.json'))
   config['ingester']['wal'].update(enabled=True,dir=str(location/'wal'))
   if repaired:
    config['ingester']['lifecycler'].update(fixed['ingester']['lifecycler']);config['ingester']['wal'].update(fixed['ingester']['wal']);config['memberlist']['node_name']=fixed['memberlist']['node_name']
  return apply
 def ring(server):return server.request('/ring',headers={'Accept':'application/json'})['shards']
 def snapshot(path):return {p.relative_to(path).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in path.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 def bodies(server,start,end):return sorted(value[1] for stream in server.logs('{job="clone-exercise"}',start,end) for value in stream['values'])
 stamp=time.time_ns();nonce=secrets.token_hex(5);old_line='acknowledged-before-clone-'+nonce
 with Loki(directory=a,configurator=configure('a')) as initial:
  initial.push([{'stream':{'job':'clone-exercise'},'values':[[str(stamp),old_line]]}])
  assert len(ring(initial))==1 and ring(initial)[0]['id']=='cloned-ingester'
 original_tokens=json.loads((a/'tokens.json').read_text())['tokens'];original_wal=snapshot(a/'wal');assert original_wal and len(original_tokens)==128
 b.mkdir();shutil.copytree(a/'wal',b/'wal');shutil.copy2(a/'tokens.json',b/'tokens.json')
 assert snapshot(b/'wal')==original_wal and json.loads((b/'tokens.json').read_text())['tokens']==original_tokens
 with Loki(directory=a,configurator=configure('a')) as original:
  assert bodies(original,stamp-1,time.time_ns()+1)==[old_line]
  with Loki(directory=b,configurator=configure('b'),require_ready=False) as duplicate:
   assert original.process.poll() is None and duplicate.process.poll() is None and original.process.pid!=duplicate.process.pid
   original.wait(lambda:'existing instance found in ring' in (b/'server.log').read_text(errors='replace') and 'tokens=128' in (b/'server.log').read_text(errors='replace') and len(ring(duplicate))==1 and ring(duplicate)[0]['id']=='cloned-ingester','duplicate actually joins existing shared ingester identity/tokens',seconds=12)
   for server in (original,duplicate):
    rows=ring(server);assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['id']=='cloned-ingester' and rows[0]['state']=='ACTIVE',rows
   assert original.config['ingester']['lifecycler']['id']==duplicate.config['ingester']['lifecycler']['id']
   print('NATIVE_TWO_MEMBERLIST_PROCESSES_CLONED_WAL_AND_TOKENS_COLLIDE_IN_ONE_INGESTER_OWNER',flush=True)
   # Isolate only the bad clone; avoid letting its normal shutdown unregister the shared original identity.
   duplicate.process.kill();duplicate.process.wait(3)
  preserved_wal=snapshot(b/'wal');preserved_tokens=(b/'tokens.json').read_bytes();assert preserved_wal
  with Loki(directory=b,configurator=configure('b',repaired=True)) as repaired:
   def healthy():
    rows=ring(original);return len(rows)==2 and {r['id'] for r in rows}=={'cloned-ingester','fresh-ingester'} and all(r['state']=='ACTIVE' for r in rows)
   original.wait(healthy,'two distinct live ring owners',seconds=12)
   repaired.wait(lambda:len(ring(repaired))==2,'ring converges on repaired node',seconds=12)
   membership=ring(original);assert len({r['address'] for r in membership})==2
   tokens=[token for entry in membership for token in entry['tokens']];assert len(tokens)==len(set(tokens))==256
   assert json.loads((a/'tokens.json').read_text())['tokens']==original_tokens,'original ownership tokens changed'
   assert snapshot(b/'wal')==preserved_wal and (b/'tokens.json').read_bytes()==preserved_tokens,'quarantined clone state was deleted/rewritten'
   fresh_tokens=json.loads(pathlib.Path(approved['tokens_file']).read_text())['tokens'];assert len(fresh_tokens)==128 and not set(fresh_tokens)&set(original_tokens)
   now=time.time_ns();new_lines=['after-fix-'+nonce+'-'+str(i) for i in range(24)]
   original.push([{'stream':{'job':'clone-exercise','source':'new-'+str(i)},'values':[[str(now),line]]} for i,line in enumerate(new_lines)])
   expected=sorted([old_line]+new_lines)
   original.wait(lambda:bodies(original,stamp-1,now+1)==expected,'original query retains acknowledged data and new streams',seconds=5)
   repaired.wait(lambda:bodies(repaired,stamp-1,now+1)==expected,'repaired query sees same recent data',seconds=5)
   assert snapshot(b/'wal')==preserved_wal and (b/'tokens.json').read_bytes()==preserved_tokens
   assert pathlib.Path(approved['wal_dir']).is_dir() and snapshot(pathlib.Path(approved['wal_dir'])),'fresh active WAL missing'
 print('NATIVE_UNIQUE_RING_TOKEN_OWNERSHIP_ORIGINAL_ACKNOWLEDGED_DATA_AND_QUARANTINED_WAL_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
